title: Cardinal Billing Account Final Bill, Refund, Write-Off and Collections Figures
content:
These Cardinal Billing Account figures apply to final earned-premium bills, refunds of credit balances, small-balance write-offs and collections referrals.

| Pay plan | Final earned-premium bill due (calendar days after cancellation) | Collections referral (calendar days after cancellation) | Smallest balance referred to collections | Largest debit written off at close | Smallest credit refunded at close | Refund issued within (calendar days) | Check or EFT clearing before refund (business days) | Refund to the original electronic method |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Direct Bill Monthly Plan | 20 | 45 | $25.00 | $4.99 | $5.00 | 30 | 10 | Yes |
| Cardinal Card Autopay Monthly Plan | 20 | 45 | $25.00 | $4.99 | $5.00 | 30 | 10 | Yes |
| Cardinal EFT Autopay Monthly Plan | 20 | 45 | $25.00 | $4.99 | $5.00 | 15 | 10 | Yes |
| Cardinal Three-Pay Plan | 20 | 45 | $25.00 | $4.99 | $5.00 | 30 | 10 | Yes |
| Cardinal Two-Pay Plan | 20 | 45 | $25.00 | $4.99 | $5.00 | 30 | 10 | Yes |
| Cardinal Paid-in-Full Plan | 20 | 45 | $25.00 | $4.99 | $5.00 | 15 | 10 | Yes |

## Notes

- Refund timing differs only on the Cardinal EFT Autopay Monthly Plan and the Cardinal Paid-in-Full Plan, which issue refunds within 15 calendar days; the other plans within 30.
- The clearing period is counted in business days, not calendar days.
- A credit below $5.00 at account close is not refunded, and a debit up to $4.99 at account close is not billed; both are written off.

Hypothetical reading: a final earned-premium balance of $24.00 is below the $25.00 collections minimum on every plan; a balance of $25.00 meets it.
